title: [sonic-broadcom] Incorrect kernel image package installed
author: pphuchar
body:

**Description**

<!--
Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->
The unsigned kernel image package(linux-image-4.19.0-6-amd64-unsigned) installed to Debian buster was replaced by the signed version(linux-image-4.19.0-6-amd64) when building sonic-broadcom image.

This happens when the script try to install opennsl-module package(and others that have keyword depends: linux-image-4.19.0-6-amd64)

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. `make target/sonic-broadcom.bin`
2. Inspect the target/sonic-broadcom.bin.log
3. Inspect the package list after sonic install and boot.
  `sudo dpkg -l | grep linux-image`

**Describe the results you received:**
The kernel image was replaced by a signed version from Debian repo.

**Describe the results you expected:**
The linux-image-4.19.0-6-amd64-unsigned installed correctly with all kernel modules from sonic-linux-kernel.

